pages.text: The Lumenwrights are gone; only ruins remain. Find broken Vestige Outposts, village-sized Vestige Cities (some Grand, with spires), buried Vaults, and abandoned Luminite Mines with $(l:liftshafts)liftshafts$(/l).

Their material is Glowbrick, refined from Luminite ore (ore → raw → smelt to ingot → glowbrick). Memory Crystals and Glyph Tablets hold fragments of their story, and their machines run on the $(l:resonance_network)Resonance Network$(/l) — still guarded by the $(l:echo_sentinel)Echo Sentinel$(/l).
Tip: run /locate structure lumenwilds:vestige_mine to find the nearest city with a mineshaft.
